claim: Current PHP 8.5 regression compatibility within the executed matrices, including shared APIs and paired version boundaries; not certification renewal.

trees.src: shared parser, matcher, lexer, adapters and public APIs
trees.tests: complete current regression suite, test discovery, helpers and cross-version fixtures
trees.grammar: registered independent grammars exercised by the current suite
trees.bin: consumer CLI and conformance entry points
trees.tools: all current validators, runners, source locks and dependency policies
trees.vendor: actual installed runtime and test dependencies

documentation: All existing docs/8.5 records except compatibility outputs; explicit PHP 8.6 evidence dependencies in documentation-inputs.json. New PHP 8.6 prose outside that list is excluded unless referenced by a manifest or literal executable dependency.

exclusions.docs/8.5/compatibility/: revision-specific generated observations, independently checked as outputs; never executable input
exclusions.docs/8.6/hybrid-evidence/: implementation assessment outputs, not consumed by runtime tests
exclusions..audit/: external caches/snapshots are verified separately; ignored scratch files are not runtime inputs
exclusions.unreferenced PHP 8.6 research prose: no input edge to this bounded current compatibility claim

historical: Separate historical-integrity-v1 result is required by the hybrid consumer, not implied by current compatibility.
legacy: Legacy repository-wide freshness and all legacy release obligations remain unchanged. No schema-1 gate is relabeled or granted by this bounded companion.
